race.description: Atr Pest Solutions Pty Ltd Plate (C1)
race.comment: CALL ME RHONDA (4) progressed nicely last time out to finish just a length from the winner in second over 2200m at Donald. Not much tougher this time so can go one better. WIZARD'S STAR (11) has put together back-to-back placings, the latest when third over 2000m at Hawkesbury. Drops back to the mile and gets a good chance to finally get off the mark. BLOW ON THE DICE (1) is knocking on the door after placing at his last three outings, most recently when second over 1400m at Wodonga when he was prominent throughout. Best figures measure up and gets the key booking of Loy. HUSSY LA VISTA (5) raced close to the lead before clearing out to score an effortless win over 1410m at Sapphire Coast last time. Cannot be underestimated. MANZOBEEL (7) is ticking along nicely and gets the 4kg claimer on to get her in light. Worth including.
